command.scope: Official public fresh runtime dependency closure extraction, git apply --check, git apply, and exact comparison of all six changed paths. This command does not rerun tests.

finalization: The final return adds completed reports and these replay receipts. Its source.patch must remain byte-identical to the replayed candidate; final packaging separately enforces this equality.
limitations: Declared runtime dependency closure only; not a full original packet extraction.
The replay receipt names the candidate ZIP, not the final report-enriched return ZIP.
No production battery rerun, unrestricted program uniqueness claim, or new training admission.
checkout_retention: The temporary fresh checkout was removed after hash-comparing all six changed files and retaining the receipt and compressed extraction inventory, to reclaim scarce filesystem inodes.
